$comment: Generated from repository.yaml by `uv run dd-gen-schema <path to repository.yaml>`. Do not edit.

Affiliation.description: The researcher's institution, matched against the institutions a registry lists.
Affiliation.title: Affiliation

RepositoryRef.description: A repository named by a funder, journal, institution or the researcher. The re3data identifier is used when given; otherwise the name is looked up.
RepositoryRef.title: RepositoryRef

description: What a dataset needs of a repository. With mandated repositories, the agent describes them; with none, it shortlists. The mandate and the access constraint come from Phase 2 (governance), usually by way of the orchestrator.

schema_class.description: Type designator: the name of the class this object is an instance of. Discriminates the input and payload unions, and lets a consumer name a payload class it does not recognise.

themes.description: The dataset's discipline, as the broad field of study (e.g. environmental science), and any narrower subjects as further themes. A narrow topic alone (e.g. moorland) may match no repository of the discipline.

data_kinds.description: What the data is, each in one to three words, e.g. interview transcripts, survey microdata or time series. A repository matches a kind only if its record has every word, so a long description (e.g. environmental data logger time series) matches none.

access.description: How the data may be accessed once deposited, as decided in Phase 2. Unset means not yet decided, and no access need is checked.

mandated.description: Repositories that a funder, journal or institutional policy requires, as Phase 2 found them. Naming an institution does not make its repository mandated.

affiliation.description: The researcher's institution. Its repositories are offered as a fallback, after those of the dataset's discipline and before generalist ones, and none is removed, so give the themes as if it were not set.

country.description: The country of the researcher's institution, as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code (e.g. GBR), as re3data writes it. A repository that already matches ranks a little higher when operated in this country; it adds no repository to the shortlist on its own. Unset, it is the country re3data records for the affiliation's institution, where re3data lists one.

title: RepositoryNeeds
